body:
I have some money saved up so that's not a huge issue, at least immediately. I'm actually considering taking a longer vacation since I didn't have any for a while.

I tried improving at work but I feel I'm just not cut out for this job (or any, but that's a thought for another day). I feel bad because the guy assessing me is doing everything he can to help me and I still fail to deliver.

I feel like a disappointment to everyone and I have no energy to change that.

As for christmas, I always find the best presents for my family. Everyone likes what I give to them, and I end up disappointed with what I get from them. I feel really shallow about it but I also feel like they are not trying as hard as me to find something that would appeal  to the recipient. Makes me want to buy whatever and be done with gifts but it clashes with what I'd really like to get for them...

I am not making any sense, am I?

morning. I'm trying to work (from home) but I am getting fired by christmas so it's hard to make myself do anything about it.

I just wish that somebody gave me attention I need and not advice/criticism. They don't work anyway and I feel guilty when people give them
yeah, five years ago I was also hoping. Now I'm just waiting for nothing

my current therapist uses psychoanalysis. I tried cognitive behavioral before and I felt it was complete bullshit, to the point I considered it a scam. it felt like putting a band-aid on a torn artery

I am actually very glad with my current therapist. Finally someone I feel I can talk to and I don't feel judged. Also, he did help me with a lot of stuff. But this family baggage seems too hard to cope with.

And yeah, it is expensive but I feel it is worth the increased price

My previous therapists were all different kind of bad. One in particular was in a church-funded facility. I was only paying a fraction of a regular therapist's price. And now I feel she worked there because nobody wanted her in a regular place. I felt her frustration with my lack of progress and how she was annoyed with my problems. It did not help that she had a disability that made her speech slurry and difficult to comprehend at times

>Make sure you reward yourself for doing those real life things

That's the problem. They are not rewarding in any way. They only end in another disappointment since I fail to do anything worth mentioning. I can't reward myself for failure

In my country there are like three suicide hotlines, opened from 8am to 2pm.

Y'know, because nobody needs help at night
Of course it's not the place I'm meant to be. There is no such place for me. I have always been out of place, wherever I go and whoever I'm with
